recentItems.title: Aavagaman - Full Song | Hanuman Ansh | Sadhu Tiwari | Shobhinaw | Har Har Mahadev | Shiv Shambhu
recentItems.description:
Times Music presents 'Aavagaman' from the movie 'Hanuman Ansh', sung by Sadhu Tiwari. Featuring the chants Har Har Mahadev and Shiv Shambhu, this bhajan is a devotee's prayer to Bhole Shankar for freedom from aavagaman, the endless cycle of coming and going, and for lasting refuge at his feet.

At its heart lies the belief that beyond the illusions of the world, Mahadev remains the one true refuge: 'Ye Duniya Ek Chhalawa, Tu Saancha Thaur Hai Baba.' With the recurring prayer 'Aavagaman Mita Do Bhole Shankar', the song carries the emotion of surrender to Bholenath through life's uncertainties and difficult paths. 

Play this Shiv bhajan for daily Shiv pooja, Monday prayers, Sawan, temple worship, or moments of meditation.
